high_level_description: stc brand style, an aerial drone shot of Mecca at dusk featuring the Abraj Al-Bait clock tower and the Grand Mosque.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A moody teal-colored dusk sky with dark clouds, mountains in the background, a modern cityscape of high-rise buildings and hotels with glass facades, and warm city lights glowing throughout the scene.

elements.desc: The Abraj Al-Bait clock tower with its golden spire dominating the center of the frame.
The Kaaba and the Grand Mosque complex, its white facade illuminated by internal lighting, visible in the foreground.
